name: Business and operations
definition: Running the business day to day: operations, supply chain, suppliers and partners, people, systems, products and execution.

name: Macroeconomic and industry conditions
definition: Economic conditions, demand, prices, inflation, interest and exchange rates, and conditions in the company's industry.

name: Strategy and competition
definition: Competitors, competitive position, changes in the business model, new products and growth strategy.

name: Legal and regulatory
definition: Laws, regulation, government action, compliance, litigation, tax rules and the company's legal structure.

name: Intellectual property
definition: Protecting the company's intellectual property and claims that it infringes others'.

name: Cybersecurity and data privacy
definition: Security breaches, cyberattacks, data protection, privacy and abuse of the company's platforms.

name: Financial, capital and securities
definition: Liquidity, debt, capital markets, investments, the company's stock and financial condition.

name: International operations
definition: Operating across countries: geopolitics, trade, tariffs and local rules abroad.

name: Corporate transactions
definition: Acquisitions, divestitures, separations and other strategic transactions.

name: General
definition: Risks the filing itself lists as general: catastrophic events, stock volatility and other risks common to most companies.
